evidence.title: Physics-Constrained Deep Learning Model for Contactless Blood Pressure Monitoring from Triaxial Bodyseismography

summary: Researchers have created a deep‑learning model that integrates physics‑based constraints to estimate blood pressure without a cuff, leveraging signals from triaxial bodyseismography sensors. This contactless method could enable more comfortable, continuous monitoring and advance wearable health‑tech solutions.
title: Physically-Constrained Deep Learning Enables Contactless Blood Pressure Monitoring via Triaxial Bodyseismography
